changelog: Plex-inspired Jellyfin Web video player: slim timeline, compact bottom controls, footer title, centered transport on wide screens, and responsive controls on smaller screens. Retains native playback, seeking, volume, audio/subtitle/settings menus, fullscreen, episode transitions, and control visibility. Adds a default-enabled Appearance opt-out and preserves legacy settings. Fixes the global theme overriding Jellyfin's transparent playback background. TV and unrecognized player structures retain their native layout.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
